verdict.rationale: An API client could plausibly connect to MCP servers and use their tools, so this axis applies to Hoppscotch. However, the evidence only documents Hoppscotch's own MCP server, which exposes its collections to external agents. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about. The built-in AI features (renaming requests, generating payloads and scripts) show no way to plug in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
